description:
The Only VIKINGS Build You'll Need To Get Conqueror by Swaggy Professor. This is a Boom 2 TC build to take advantage of Viking automatically training Villagers for free.

Note: I made this version of the build to be as accurate as possible to the original as shown in the video. This may make it a bit harder to fully grasp at first.
For a more simpler version, please check out murtuk's version here: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/eDD62wG5UJ5InP5OygNR

Will be updated with new icons as soon as they're released.

Cheers!
name: The Only VIKINGS Build You'll Need To Get Conqueror - Swaggy Professor
author: Niki45nk

notes: 6 Vills to @resource/sheep.webp@
Rally 3 Vills to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (also build Mining Camp)
1 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vill builds [Longhouse] on corner of [Town Center] away from @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Rally new Vills to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
When there is 3900 Gold left in @resource/resource_gold.webp@vein, send 3 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ Vills to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
2 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills build [Konungar Hall] (or Baugr Fort if preferred)
All other @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
Rally 2 new Vills to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (also build Mining Camp)
Send 3 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ Vills also to @resource/resource_stone.webp@
Then Rally new Vills back to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
When 8 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ Vills, Rally new Vills to build Landmark
When there is 900 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ left in @resource/resource_stone.webp@ vein:
9 @resource/resource_wood.webp@Vills build 2nd [Town Center] near @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Send all @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and [Landmark] Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ near 2nd [Town Center]
When 2nd [Town Center] finishes, 9 builder Vills build [Longhouse]
[If your opponent is planning to attack you]
Put Vills equally between @resource/resource_food.webp@/@resource/resource_wood.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@ to make Spearmen and Shield Maidens
[If opponent is not planning to attack you]
Put all Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Upgrade 2 [Longhouses] with Bee Skepps
Build more [Longhouses] and upgrade with Queue Smithy
